item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your reminders keep pointing at one question: does this moment support the life you're trying to create? Notice when your mind starts predicting or assuming what others think. That's a thought, not a fact. Test it before you believe it. Pair that with your meditation and your check-in this evening. Small pauses add up. Your action: before your next decision today, stop, take one slow breath, and ask that question out loud.
